Stream's OpenSpotSaavnApi independently adapts the JioSaavn request format,
search transport, and media address format documented in OpenSpot Music 3.1.5:
https://github.com/BlackHatDevX/openspot-music-app
Reference: openspot-mobile/lib/api.ts, source commit 640af82.

The public search relay is operated by a third party.
